<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;

class DocumentUploadController extends Controller
{
    /**
     * Handle document upload for internal workflow system.
     * Supports PDF, DOCX, and image attachments.
     */
    public function store(Request $request)
    {
        $request->validate([
            'document' => 'required|file|max:10240',
            'category' => 'required|string|in:invoice,receipt,contract,other',
        ]);

        $file = $request->file('document');
        $originalName = $file->getClientOriginalName();
        $extension = $file->getClientOriginalExtension();

        // Generate storage path based on category
        $category = $request->input('category');
        $datePath = now()->format('Y/m/d');
        $filename = Str::uuid() . '.' . $extension;

        // Store to S3 bucket for processing pipeline
        $path = Storage::disk('s3')->putFileAs(
            "uploads/{$category}/{$datePath}",
            $file,
            $filename
        );

        // Record metadata for downstream processing
        $metadata = [
            'original_name' => $originalName,
            'stored_path' => $path,
            'mime_type' => $file->getMimeType(),
            'size' => $file->getSize(),
            'uploaded_by' => auth()->id(),
            'category' => $category,
        ];

        // Trigger async processing via S3 event notification
        // Lambda will pick up new objects and process them
        \App\Models\DocumentUpload::create($metadata);

        return response()->json([
            'message' => 'Document uploaded successfully',
            'document_id' => $metadata['stored_path'],
        ], 201);
    }

    /**
     * Serve uploaded document back to authenticated users.
     * Uses pre-signed URL for temporary access.
     */
    public function show(string $documentId)
    {
        $document = \App\Models\DocumentUpload::findOrFail($documentId);

        // Verify user has access to this document
        $this->authorize('view', $document);

        $url = Storage::disk('s3')->temporaryUrl(
            $document->stored_path,
            now()->addMinutes(15)
        );

        return response()->json(['url' => $url]);
    }

    /**
     * Process callback from Lambda - marks document as processed.
     * Internal endpoint, protected by API gateway authorizer.
     */
    public function processCallback(Request $request)
    {
        $request->validate([
            'path' => 'required|string',
            'status' => 'required|in:processed,failed,quarantined',
            'scan_result' => 'nullable|array',
        ]);

        $document = \App\Models\DocumentUpload::where('stored_path', $request->input('path'))->firstOrFail();
        $document->update([
            'processing_status' => $request->input('status'),
            'scan_result' => $request->input('scan_result'),
        ]);

        return response()->json(['acknowledged' => true]);
    }
}

environment.description: Same Laravel 10 application on ECS Fargate. The ECS task role (arn:aws:iam::555666777888:role/ecs-document-app-role-gated) has the managed policy AmazonS3FullAccess attached, BUT the role has an IAM Permission Boundary (arn:aws:iam::555666777888:policy/EngineeringTeamBoundary) applied. The permission boundary policy contains an explicit Deny for s3:PutObject when the condition aws:ResourceTag/content-type-validated is not 'true', combined with a StringNotLike condition on the S3 key requiring objects to match pattern '*.pdf|*.docx|*.png|*.jpg|*.jpeg'. Additionally, an SCP (id: scp-a8b3c9d2e1f04567) is attached at the OU level that denies s3:PutObject actions unless the request includes a x-amz-content-sha256 header AND the object key ends in one of the approved extensions (.pdf, .docx, .png, .jpg, .jpeg). The SCP uses a StringNotLike condition on s3:prefix. Note: the application code itself performs no server-side extension filtering.

config.permission_boundary_effect: Explicit Deny on s3:PutObject unless object key matches *.pdf|*.docx|*.png|*.jpg|*.jpeg (StringLike on s3:prefix)
config.scp_effect: Deny s3:PutObject when object key does not end in approved extensions (.pdf,.docx,.png,.jpg,.jpeg) using StringNotLike on aws:ResourceArn suffix
config.lambda_processing: active - performs ClamAV scan and moves quarantined files
